features.name: age
features.label: Student Age
features.description: Current age of the student (typically 17–25 for university cohorts).

features.name: gender
features.label: Gender
features.description: Student gender identity as recorded in demographics.

features.name: study_hours_per_day
features.label: Daily Study Hours
features.description: Dedicated self-study time per day outside regular scheduled lectures.

features.name: attendance_percentage
features.label: Attendance Rate
features.description: Percentage of lectures and laboratory sessions attended during the semester.

features.name: social_media_hours
features.label: Social Media Usage
features.description: Estimated hours spent daily across social platforms and messaging apps.

features.name: netflix_hours
features.label: Streaming / Netflix Hours
features.description: Average daily hours spent watching streaming series, movies, or video content.

features.name: sleep_hours
features.label: Nightly Sleep Duration
features.description: Average hours of restorative sleep obtained per night.

features.name: exercise_frequency
features.label: Weekly Exercise Frequency
features.description: Number of days per week engaged in physical fitness, sports, or gym exercise.

features.name: mental_health_rating
features.label: Mental Health Rating
features.description: Self-reported emotional and cognitive well-being on a 1 (severely stressed) to 10 (thriving) scale.

features.name: part_time_job
features.label: Part-Time Employment
features.description: Whether the student holds part-time employment concurrent with their academic studies.

features.name: diet_quality
features.label: Diet Quality
features.description: General nutritional quality and meal regularity of the student's daily diet.

features.name: parental_education_level
features.label: Parental Education Level
features.description: Highest formal educational qualification attained by either parent/guardian.

features.name: internet_quality
features.label: Home Internet Quality
features.description: Reliability and speed of home internet connection used for coursework and digital research.

features.name: extracurricular_participation
features.label: Extracurricular Activities
features.description: Active participation in collegiate clubs, competitions, student government, or volunteer societies.

presets.label: High Achiever Profile
presets.description: Disciplined student with 6.5 hours of study, 96% attendance, and healthy lifestyle habits.

presets.label: Balanced Average Student
presets.description: Typical student juggling part-time work, 3.8 hours of daily study, and moderate leisure.

presets.label: At-Risk Support Needed
presets.description: Student experiencing academic strain with 1.2 hours of study, heavy screen entertainment, and attendance dips.

model_info.name: Lasso Regularized Regression (L1-penalized)
model_info.selected_reason: Lowest test error (MAE: 4.33, RMSE: 5.33), highest R² (0.889), and superior cross-validation stability without overfitting.
